numeric.domainFloat: IEEE-754 binary32 rounded after every named arithmetic operation
numeric.invalid: NaN, infinity, negative delta and unsupported enum fail evidence-required
numeric.clamp: only a formula explicitly named below may clamp

random.system_iteration: sort current semantic systems by (bundle key, semantic identity) once per session
random.system_seed_assignment: one current xorshift128 step per stable system in portable iteration order
random.particle_slot_generation: for each birth, advance the owning per-system xorshift128 stream once per slot, then apply the current seed-derived sample expression
random.event_random_stream: burst probability, rate and shape consume the same owning system stream in chronological event order before birth slots
random.frame_partition: birth events are ordered by exact Float32 event time and stable event sequence; each particle update samples its immutable 12 slots so coarse and split outer frames do not consume different random counts
random.reset: session reset reconstructs the fixed portable global state; clear removes live particles but does not rewind the owning system stream; retry creates a new session stream

emission.interval: events in (previousTime,currentTime], with time-zero bursts included on first step
emission.burst: serialized time/count/cycle/repeat/probability; current probability is uniformly 1
emission.rate: analytic n/rate timestamps per duration cycle
emission.capacity: drop a birth when live count already equals maxNumParticles; never steal
emission.expiry: update existing, remove expired, then process chronologically ordered births
emission.prewarm: analytically seed one preceding duration at Play before the first outer frame
emission.culling: portable simulation always advances while engine runs; serialized culling mode is retained only for the difference report

states.2: random lerp of scaled min/max cubic Hermite curves

gradientStates.4: maxGradient sampled by immutable random slot

curves.gradientTime: uint16 key times with component-wise linear interpolation

shape.cone: slot11 azimuth; slot10 radius/thickness; serialized angle gives direction
shape.transform: system local TRS then parent TRS in stored order

update.clampVelocity: when speed exceeds magnitude, lerp speed toward magnitude by dampen

renderer.handoff: one immutable sorted sample after particle update per host outer frame
renderer.texture: current RGBA SHA/size plus material texture name; Pixi upload is backend-only
renderer.blend: Mobile/Particles/Additive maps add; other locked material maps normal

frameTransaction.preflight: all business, particle, audio and render/sample batches before any commit
frameTransaction.meaning: semantic phase only; no physical audible/visible ordering claim
frameTransaction.laterFailure: discard all staged domains and preserve prior committed snapshot

lifecycle.route_mapping: use the closed current route table exactly; unsupported enum or invalid range fails evidence-required before command publication
lifecycle.play_restart: non-null active route emits Stop(clear), Clear, then Play atomically; inactive emits Play; resources are preflight-complete so runtime null is an invariant fault
lifecycle.outer_frame: advance particle simulation exactly once per host outer frame with Float32 delta; never once per adaptive NoteManager substep
lifecycle.pause: freeze particle domain with the engine clock and consume no random/event draws until resume; this intentionally differs from native UI-pause continuation
lifecycle.movetime: particle backend refuses standalone seek; the host must restore a whole-engine checkpoint and deterministically replay. Entering MoveTime clears all live particles, route commands remain suppressed in state 14, and replay reconstructs particles/random together with notes, score, life, skill, audio and render state
lifecycle.game_over_and_natural_end: after the terminal semantic frame, clear all particles and publish one final empty sample
lifecycle.retry_and_reset: clear all, discard system streams, then construct a fresh session from the fixed portable global state
lifecycle.fault: preflight and stage all particle commands/simulation samples before publication; on fault publish nothing and preserve the last committed cross-domain frame
lifecycle.dispose: clear all live particles and release resource/backend handles exactly once; repeat dispose is idempotent
lifecycle.repeat_session: no particle identity, state, random stream, command sequence or renderer handle survives into the next session
lifecycle.targeted_r1: not launched: current managed route and accepted MoveTime facts answer the actionable static questions; physical scene-destruction cleanup cannot close the exact identity claim on the fixed device and is replaced only for portable product delivery
